label: PICALM::MLLT10

sections.text: PICALM encodes a clathrin-associated adaptor involved in endocytosis.
MLLT10 encodes AF10, a chromatin-associated regulator that recruits the H3K79 methyltransferase DOT1L.

The CALM::AF10 fusion uses PICALM-associated trafficking/export interactions and MLLT10-mediated DOT1L recruitment to activate HOXA-associated transcription. It is recurrent in T-ALL and occurs less often in AML.
